component.name: Hexer
component.summary: Hex editor for huge files, process memory and disks

description.p: Hexer is a fast, dark-mode hex editor. It streams files straight from disk, so a multi-terabyte disk image opens as fast as a small packet capture, and every edit can be undone, even after a save or a restart.

ul.li: Overwrite, insert, delete, fill and paste with a full undo history
Hex patterns with wildcards, text and UTF-16 search in the background
Data inspector, bookmarks, side-by-side compare, strings, hashes and checksums
Lua parsers that turn raw bytes into an editable structure tree
Process memory and raw disks, an entropy minimap, packet captures and x86 disassembly
